recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎由脂肪空泡與藍色間質網絡、微血管組成，其中只散布小型淋巴球與少數巨噬細胞，缺乏成群的紅系、骨髓系前驅細胞與巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血的低細胞性顆粒。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of fat cells (clear round spaces) outlined by a meshwork of blue-staining stroma
Branching capillaries lined by elongated endothelial cells running through the particle
Sparse residual cells, mostly small round lymphocytes with scattered macrophages and stromal cells
No identifiable megakaryocytes, erythroid islands or granulocytic maturation within the particle
Peripheral blood red cells in the background
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly hypocellular particle composed largely of adipocytes and a prominent stromal framework, including capillaries lined by endothelial cells. The residual cellular elements are mostly small lymphocytes with occasional macrophages and stromal cells; megakaryocytes and maturing erythroid or granulocytic precursors are not identified. No abnormal infiltrate or blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with a profoundly hypocellular marrow, in keeping with aplastic anemia; a trephine biopsy is required to confirm global cellularity.

ddx.vs: A hemodilute specimen lacks particles altogether or shows cellular particles with dilution of the trails, whereas here the particle itself is fatty and devoid of hematopoiesis.
Hypoplastic MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, dyserythropoiesis or increased blasts among residual cells, which are absent here.
Residual cells would include a population of blasts rather than predominantly mature small lymphocytes and macrophages.
Hairy cell leukemia shows mononuclear cells with 'fried-egg' spacing and hairy projections, with CD20/CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells by flow.
